main_text.p: sta ab isto institutionis exordio agnoscamus ac celebremus hanc immensam bonitatem fi-lij Dei, quod sanctissimum suum corpus, & purifsimū suum sanguinem cum nostris cor-poribus multis modis pollutis, & horrendis infirmitatibus contaminatis coniungere non dedignatur.
main_text.head: XL.
main_text.p: Detestemur simul & veterum & nouorum Sacramentariorū varias & multiplices glo-sas & interpretationes de signo, typo, figura & symbolo.
main_text.head: XLI.
main_text.p: Non enim potest inueniri locus vllus in scriptura, qui testetur Christum non adesse in cœna, vt necesse sit ad allegorias tropos & fi-guras confugere.
main_text.head: XLII.
main_text.p: Proprijssime namq; Christus in cœna lo-qui, neq; vlla figurata loquutione hunc sacro sanctum thesaurum ecclesiæ suæ inuoluere voluit.
main_text.head: XLIII.
main_text.p: Firmissima ergo & indubitata fide appre-hendamus hęc clara & genuina Christi verba in genuino sensu, quem natura, vsitata Gram-matica, & certa ipsorum significatio reddit.

page.notes: The running head reads "PROPOSITI MVSCVLI" with a dagger-like mark after PROPOSIT; the scan is slightly skewed and the right edge is dark. The last numeral XLIIII is set right-aligned after the paragraph.
